name: duma
text: duma is an Irish word meaning mound, tumulus, or barrow, and it names a burial-ground in the landscape. The term appears as a recurring element in many ancient Irish place-names. A recorded example is Duma na nGall, the mound of the foreign hostages, located at Tara.

attributes.attribute: Irish term for mound, tumulus, barrow, and burial-ground, recurring in ancient place-names

okr.objective: duma is recorded as the Irish word for a mound, tumulus, or barrow used for a burial-ground and as a place-name element.
